summary: Verified fix for missing AI session analysis on WorkoutDetail. Global axios interceptor in src/index.js now injects X-User-Id: default on all /api requests. Backend curl confirmed: all 4 analysis endpoints return 200 with header, 403 without (expected). Frontend UI /workout/garmin-23473184085 fully displays: header metrics (Intensity Moderate, Load 10.1km, Type Easy), What it means, Coach advice, and Enhanced analysis section populated with LLM text and comparison. Regression checks passed on /sessions, /training, /progress, /subscription — no paywalls, trial banner shown, no failing API requests.
critical_code_review_comments: Global axios interceptor uses a hardcoded USER_ID='default' string. Fine for single-user MVP but should be replaced by session/auth-derived id when auth is added.
Interceptor matches both API_BASE_URL prefix and any URL containing '/api/' — safe but slightly loose; consider gating on API_BASE_URL only.
seed_data_creation: None. Only GET requests issued against existing user_id=default trial account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix from iter_27 (global axios X-User-Id interceptor in src/index.js) is verified working. WorkoutDetail AI analysis renders end-to-end. All app tabs regressed OK. Sample workout id garmin-23473184085 (Vannes run, Jul 4) is a reliable canary.
